description: This is a PHP source file defining the view handling for editing scheduler entries within SuiteCRM, including rendering schedule details and handling user input related to job scheduling.

classes.name: SchedulersViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit to provide UI for editing scheduled jobs, including handling of time intervals, week days, and display logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the view for editing scheduler entries, setting flags for subpanel usage.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleListParam
methods.description: Returns the HTML link for the module title in the browser title, linking back to the Schedulers module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares scheduler schedule data (such as job function, interval, days, hours) for rendering in the view, including handling of weekly schedule checkboxes and time interval inputs.
